arms.shaped: Sulekh renderReference (HarfBuzz shaping), script's kalam-style font, size medium
arms.unshaped: unshaped baseline: nominal glyph per code point, left to right, no shaping (same font/layout); not an image model
arms.shaped-plain: as shaped, with the script's plainest catalog font (OCR control); Urdu uses Noto Naskh Arabic from the work cache (not shipped)
arms.unshaped-plain: as unshaped, with the plainest font

method.ocr: tesseract.js 7.0.0 (SIMD LSTM core; see tesseract-worker.cjs), OEM LSTM_ONLY, tessdata 4.0.0_best_int, PSM 7 (single line) or 6 (two lines)
method.score: exact = NFC + whitespace-normalised equality; exactIgnoringJoiners = same after deleting U+200C/U+200D; CER = code-point Levenshtein / reference length
